items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: if they play the trombone they know all about Kid Ory and they learn the proper songs

ctx.x: The syllabi. There you go. And the teachers they get know what they know and they pay a bit of lip service to the old masters. They go back maybe as far as Charlie Parker and they might touch on the seminal influences before, and Louis Armstrong, Bix Beiderbecke, Lester Young and maybe Coleman Hawkins and probably speak about ragtime or something. They mention the Original Dixieland Jazz Band as being the first to record. But from what I gather from friends of mine who have gone through these courses, they really…
Okay. Is there an integrated jazz scene in Australia at all?
